findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.curatedapi.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: calc_check_cusip · Private data: calc_date_timezone_convert, calc_excel_db, calc_finance_mortgage, validate_einvoice_en16931, validate_einvoice_peppol_bis, validate_einvoice_xrechnung · Public sink: calc_finance_black_76, calc_finance_mortgage_affordability, calc_money_allocate · Destructive: calc_check_vat_number, calc_math_rounding, validate_einvoice_xrechnung.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: calc_check_cusip · Private data: calc_date_timezone_convert, calc_excel_db, calc_finance_mortgage, validate_einvoice_en16931, validate_einvoice_peppol_bis, validate_einvoice_xrechnung · Public sink: calc_finance_black_76, calc_finance_mortgage_affordability, calc_money_allocate · Destructive: calc_check_vat_number, calc_math_rounding, validate_einvoice_xrechnung

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
